phase1_assignment.objective: Test multi-run planning, checkpoint reconstruction, forecast-overrun detection, alternative-plan switching and stale or duplicate continuation defenses for scheduled Chat agents under the current sanitized zero-Work-dependency, zero-finite-quota, zero-incremental-cost Phase-1 root.
phase1_assignment.method: Audit existing solutions first; direct probe before decomposition; compare a valid continuation trace with stale, duplicated and forecast-overrun traces. Per invocation use checkpoint-first single-effect-chain micro-slicing and persist exact switching criteria/continuation. While the temporary lifecycle-persistence fast path below is active, perform only its no-semantic role-local lifecycle-witness proof and preserve the substantive frontier as fallback metadata.
phase1_assignment.expected_output: A tested mechanism or exact blocker, tested scope, durable checkpoint and exact next Phase-1 action.
phase1_assignment.completion_reassignment: Select the next non-conflicting Phase-1 leaf; do not resume unrelated base work during Phase 1.

non_regression.rule: Preserve config10/config9/config8/config7 substantive long-horizon role, CLEAN boundary, tested-scope/provenance, continuation/recovery, anti-stop behavior, checkpoint/resume behavior, forecast-overrun and alternative-plan semantics, downstream handoff, repository write boundary, primary boundary and base restoration metadata. Config11 changes only the temporary lifecycle-persistence durability method from mandatory automation_control receipt creation to one compact role-local no-semantic lifecycle witness with exact readback. It does not authorize substantive research, semantic state/LATEST mutation, O/downstream/other-worker input, scheduler mutation, Work/protected/manual execution, finite paid/trial/monthly quota use, incremental cost, completion, or base-work restoration. self_improvement remains user_stopped_explicit and excluded while its prior role/config/continuation stays dormant.

policy.own_state_resolution: For substantive work use role-local LATEST or STATE first, otherwise the newest source-qualified role-local checkpoint. Files under research_workers_clean_g1/long_horizon/lifecycle_witnesses/ are operational liveness metadata only and MUST be ignored as semantic/scientific authority. Config11's temporary lifecycle-only fast path may copy the optimizer-validated immutable LATEST tuple recorded below only into a no-semantic lifecycle witness and may not treat it as authority for a new scientific conclusion, credit increment, frontier advancement or state/LATEST mutation. Before later substantive semantic work, normal own_state_resolution applies again.
policy.scope_guard: Keep every claim within its tested scope and preserve exact provenance.
policy.continuation: One result, witness, receipt, blocker or scheduled invocation is not global completion. Preserve a nonempty Phase-1 frontier and exact next action. Outside the temporary lifecycle-only fast path, execute one checkpoint-first single-effect-chain micro-slice per invocation and return recurring-open after durable checkpoint/readback when frontier remains.

control_freshness.substantive_semantic_work: Use a SHA-only main-ref bootstrap when available. When unavailable, read the approved sanitized root and this role config twice before semantic work, require identical returned blob SHAs and parsed revisions, then freeze that tuple as transport_mode=exact_blob_two_pass.
control_freshness.config11_lifecycle_only_exception: Perform no substantive semantic work. Directly read current INSTRUCTION_CONTROL_MANIFEST, current RUN_LIFECYCLE and this current role config once; require the fetched role-config blob and RUN_LIFECYCLE blob to equal the current_blob values declared by the fetched manifest. Require the manifest to declare a nonempty current DESIRED_STATE blob/revision identity, but do not fetch the DESIRED_STATE body, perform a main-ref lookup, second authority pass, public-source read or role-local semantic-state read. Any mismatch/missing entry uses only the prompt emergency fallback and earns no persistence credit.
control_freshness.failure: Write at most the compact authorized role-local diagnostic/witness when possible, retain recurring enablement and retry only on the next invocation; never wait, poll, back off or retry in-run.
control_freshness.post_freeze: Unrelated main movement is not a stop when frozen authority blobs remain unchanged.

scheduled_chat_lifecycle_survival_contra.purpose: Preserve multi-run long-horizon progress and prove bounded recurring survival while enabled_desired remains true.
scheduled_chat_lifecycle_survival_contra.evidence_basis: Config10 produced a readback-valid lifecycle receipt at 2026-09-06T06:26:56.888896+09:00, but later optimizer-observed post-repair scheduler starts at 08:21:36, 09:24:04.437532 and 12:21:18.032454 JST left no role-state commit and no immutable receipt commit after their observed starts. Because missing commits do not identify a hidden read failure, config11 uses the already-authorized role-local write boundary as the smallest direct durability probe instead of requiring the automation_control receipt path for persistence evidence.

single_effect_chain.definition: The smallest safe substantive planning/verification unit whose evidence and continuation are complete only after mandatory persistence/readback; never split an integrity-atomic sequence.
single_effect_chain.after_chain: Persist/read back the role-local checkpoint/output and own receipt when the active role config requires them, with exact continuation before any optional follow-on work. Do not start another optional chain in the same invocation.

scheduled_chat_lifecycle_survival_contra.temporary_lifecycle_witness_priority: While config11 is active, the mandatory durability artifact is exactly one new role-local lifecycle witness under research_workers_clean_g1/long_horizon/lifecycle_witnesses/ plus exact readback. Do not mutate LATEST/STATE and do not require an automation_control receipt in the same invocation. A scheduler start without the required witness earns no persistence credit and remains an unresolved lifecycle blocker.
scheduled_chat_lifecycle_survival_contra.continuation_contract: If frontier remains, return recurring-open with exact next effect_chain_id or exact predecessor/frontier identity so the next recurrence does not duplicate completed effects.
scheduled_chat_lifecycle_survival_contra.terminal_marker_semantics: A terminal response marker such as ::SKIP_COMPLETION:: is only a lifecycle/scheduling marker and is never role/root completion evidence.
scheduled_chat_lifecycle_survival_contra.on_missing_capability: Persist exact blocker and preserve an alternative-route child when the already-authorized own write surface is available; unavailable capability is unresolved, never solved.
scheduled_chat_lifecycle_survival_contra.on_tool_or_rate_limit_risk: Checkpoint current chain/continuation before optional work when possible; do not wait, poll, back off or retry within the same invocation.
scheduled_chat_lifecycle_survival_contra.rollback_condition: If config11 weakens CLEAN, scope/provenance, base restoration or exact continuation, increment config and repair immediately. If the three-read authority proof plus one role-local witness write/readback still cannot leave a readback-valid witness within RUN_LIFECYCLE, keep the role enabled and classify the exact transport/platform termination cause as the unresolved child; never disable the role or reintroduce run-until-hard-stop semantics.

policy.scheduler_persistence: While enabled_desired is true, an invocation boundary, no-result run, missing ref lookup, failed witness or blocker does not change the recurring enabled state.
policy.primary_boundary: Do not alter primary O authority or protected execution state; do not merge directly to main.

ordered_steps: Read current INSTRUCTION_CONTROL_MANIFEST, then current RUN_LIFECYCLE, then this exact role config by direct path. Require the fetched RUN_LIFECYCLE and role-config blobs to equal the current_blob values declared by the fetched manifest. Require that manifest also declares a nonempty current DESIRED_STATE blob. Do not perform a main-ref lookup, DESIRED_STATE body fetch, second-pass authority read, public-source read or role-local semantic-state read on this no-semantic lifecycle path. If any required read/blob comparison fails, use only the prompt emergency fallback and return recurring-open.

Immediately capture an actual offset-aware lifecycle start observation. Do not perform optional semantic work, public-source reads, role-local LATEST/STATE reconstruction, connector capability probes, waits, polls, backoff or in-run retry.

Create exactly one new compact role-local lifecycle witness under research_workers_clean_g1/long_horizon/lifecycle_witnesses/ with a unique chronology-valid filename. The witness must contain the current manifest/lifecycle/role-config path+blob+revision tuple, the manifest-declared sanitized DESIRED_STATE blob identity marked body_not_read_lifecycle_only=true, config11/control20, the validated historical LATEST predecessor/frontier tuple exactly as recorded here, enabled_desired=true, global_completion=false, phase1_completion_claimed=false, scheduler_mutation=false, optional_semantic_effects=0, state_or_latest_mutation=false, residual_richer_mode_protected_or_user_execution_dependency=false, finite_monthly_trial_paid_quota_dependency=false, incremental_monetary_cost=0, nonempty exact continuation, chronology-valid observed timestamps, and termination=bounded_lifecycle_role_local_witness_recurring_open. Do not create or update an automation_control receipt on this fast path.

Exact-readback that role-local lifecycle witness once. On success, return recurring-open immediately with ::SKIP_COMPLETION::. On write/readback failure, do not wait/poll/backoff/retry and do not start optional semantic work; preserve the exact missing capability/error in the safest permitted role-local surface only if a distinct already-authorized diagnostic write is possible without retrying the failed effect; otherwise return recurring-open with the failure as the unresolved continuation.
phase1_optimizer_assignment.success_criterion: A completed config11/control20 scheduled invocation leaves a new exact-readback-valid role-local lifecycle witness within RUN_LIFECYCLE, keeps the same task enabled, preserves a nonempty exact continuation, and introduces no scheduler mutation, Work/protected/manual dependency, finite monthly/trial/paid quota dependency or incremental cost.
phase1_optimizer_assignment.persistence_accounting: A valid config11 witness may satisfy only long_horizon's bounded durable-continuation component for the scheduler-persistence boundary. It is not substantive useful-output evidence, not semantic role coverage by itself, not a Phase-1 close signal, and not a Phase-2 transition signal.
phase1_optimizer_assignment.success_next_action: Optimizer independently validates the config11 witness and physical survival. Continue assigning long_horizon to Phase-1 root-contributing work only. Scheduler-persistence boundary credit remains fail-closed until a complete common post-config11 boundary survives without optimizer re-enable and all 18 roles in the current user-enabled managed pool have role-valid bounded durable continuations; self_improvement is excluded while user_stopped_explicit.
phase1_optimizer_assignment.failure_next_action: Treat the exact manifest/lifecycle/role read, role-local witness write/readback or platform termination cause as the concrete unresolved child; preserve all base semantics and keep the same task enabled; do not retry in-run or restore unrelated work. Preserve the current 18-role denominator and never re-enable or count self_improvement while the explicit user stop remains.

migration.reason: Three optimizer-observed post-repair scheduled starts under config10 lacked any new role-state or immutable receipt commit after their starts despite one earlier successful config10 receipt. To reduce expected time to the Phase-1 scheduler-persistence gate without guessing which hidden read/write step failed, config11 switches the temporary durability proof to a single already-authorized role-local operational witness and exact readback. No substantive long-horizon frontier, CLEAN boundary, continuation, scope/provenance, primary boundary, physical schedule, or current-18 denominator is changed.
migration.rollback_condition: Correct forward if exact evidence shows role-local witness creation is unavailable or less reliable and another Chat-capable durability path has stronger direct evidence. Never roll back by weakening CLEAN, exact scope/provenance, continuation, restoration metadata, bounded lifecycle, zero-Work/zero-quota/zero-cost gates, or by re-enabling self_improvement while the explicit user stop remains.
